title: Egyptian-Style Lamb Kebabs with Spiced Warmly Tacos
description: A fusion of Egyptian and Mexican flavors, these lamb kebabs are served with spiced warmly tacos for a unique and delicious meal.

ingredients.name: warmly spice blend
ingredients.notes: available at most middle eastern markets

ingredients.name: egyptian kebab spice
ingredients.notes: available at most middle eastern markets

instructions: Thread lamb cubes, onion, bell pepper, and zucchini onto skewers.
Brush lamb kebabs with olive oil and season with warmly spice blend and egyptian kebab spice.
Grill lamb kebabs for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until cooked through.
Warm taco shells according to package instructions.
Assemble tacos with grilled lamb kebabs, cilantro, shredded cheese, and salsa.
